run_codegen_helloworld: run the script to generate Python and gRPC stubs from helloworld.proto
run_codegen_route_guide: run the script to generate Python and gRPC stubs from route_guide.proto
run_protoc_main: run protoc.main to compile a .proto file into Python gRPC stubs
build_grpc_stubs: build a script that uses grpc_tools.protoc to generate Python gRPC stubs from proto files
review_codegen_script: review the run_codegen script that generates protocol messages and gRPC stubs for multiplex examples
